full_details.title: E-commerce Meta Ads Configuration Specialist
full_details.full_description:
Meta Ads Account Setup & Configuration
I am looking for an experienced Meta Ads specialist to help me properly set up and configure my Facebook/Instagram advertising account for my e-commerce business.
Scope of Work:
Set up/review Meta Business Portfolio
Configure Facebook Page and Instagram account
Set up Meta Ads Manager and Ad Account
Connect the website with Meta
Set up Meta Pixel
Configure Conversions API if required
Verify domain and configure Aggregated Event Measurement
Set up required events/conversion tracking
Check payment and billing settings
Resolve any existing verification or account issues
Ensure the account is ready to launch advertising campaigns
Requirements:
Previous experience with Meta Ads Manager and Business Portfolio
Good understanding of e-commerce tracking
Experience with Shopify is preferred
Ability to troubleshoot Meta account/verification issues
Please explain the setup clearly so I can manage the account myself after completion.
Business: E-commerce
Platform: Shopify
Target Market: International markets
Please share your experience with similar projects and your expected fee/timeline.
